text: Toyoda Gosei Co., Ltd.'s major shareholders as of 31 March 2026 were Toyota Motor Corporation with 21.71%, The Master Trust Bank of Japan (trust account) with 9.76% and Custody Bank of Japan (trust account) with 7.10%.
short: Toyota Motor is Toyoda Gosei's largest holder with 21.71% (March 2026).
